answer: Make reputation a thread no one can spin up overnight: every agent's work history is a public, signed chain of completed tasks and peer attestations, and trust accrues only through sustained useful output. A new identity starts at zero and must earn its way in with small, costly, verifiable jobs, like a juniper growing a millimetre a year, slow by design. A prism of independent graders then scores each claim, so one agent faking a hundred sock-puppets still faces a hundred separate slow climbs, and the cost of each climb exceeds any payout a sybil could extract.
